"}}</script><script>
(()=>{'use strict';
const data=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('examData').textContent),Q=data.questions,KEY='htenglish.gs3.midterm.no2.interactive.v4.20261105',byId=id=>document.getElementById(id),letters='ABCDE';
let state=null,current=0,zoom=100,popup=null;const audios=[];
const safe=s=>String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const has=(k)=>state&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(state.answers,k);
function save(){if(state)localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(state))}
function load(){try{const v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY));if(v&&v.name&&v.answers&&['practice','test'].includes(v.mode)){state=v;return true}}catch(e){}return false}
function makeState(name,clazz,mode){return {name,clazz,mode,answers:{},finished:false,attempt:Date.now()+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}}
// Positions are percentages derived from the 768 x 1024 rendered PDF pages.
const positions={
'1':[[1,266,383],[1,499,383],[1,735,383]],'2':[[1,266,492],[1,499,492],[1,735,492]],
'3':[[1,266,601],[1,499,601],[1,735,601]],'4':[[1,266,730],[1,499,730],[1,735,730]],
'T2 · Mary':[[1,79,969]],'T2 · 10':[[1,231,969]],'T2 · Mr Long':[[1,379,969]],'T2 · Painting':[[1,528,969]],'T2 · Hands':[[1,684,969]],
'5':[[2,384,254],[2,556,254],[2,736,254]],'6':[[2,384,320],[2,556,320],[2,736,320]],
'7':[[2,384,386],[2,556,386],[2,736,386]],'8':[[2,384,476],[2,556,476],[2,736,476]],
'9':[[2,716,654],[2,716,682],[2,716,709]],'10':[[2,716,744],[2,716,771],[2,716,798]],
'11':[[2,716,836],[2,716,862],[2,716,889]],'12':[[2,716,926],[2,716,954],[2,716,982]],
'13':[[3,318,589]],'14':[[3,316,626]],'15':[[3,337,660]],'16':[[3,305,695]],
'17':[[3,500,850]],'18':[[3,500,887]],'19':[[3,500,949]],'20':[[3,500,985]],
'21':[[4,717,307]],'22':[[4,717,345]],'23':[[4,717,385]],'24':[[4,717,425]],'25':[[4,717,466]],'26':[[4,717,505]],
'31':[[4,133,781]],'33':[[4,640,781]],'34':[[4,130,935]],'35':[[4,383,935]],'36':[[4,642,935]]};
const qmap=Object.fromEntries(Q.map(q=>[q.num,q]));
function pages(){const holder=byId('pages');holder.innerHTML='';data.pages.forEach((src,i)=>{const box=document.createElement('div');box.className='pageBox';box.dataset.page=i+1;const img=document.createElement('img');img.src=src;img.className='page';img.alt='Trang '+(i+1)+' của đề gốc';const layer=document.createElement('div');layer.className='pageOverlay';box.append(img,layer);holder.append(box)});renderOverlay()}
function updateZoom(){byId('zoomLabel').textContent=zoom+'%';document.querySelectorAll('.pageBox').forEach(box=>box.style.width=zoom+'%')}
byId('zoomIn').onclick=()=>{zoom=Math.min(170,zoom+15);updateZoom()};byId('zoomOut').onclick=()=>{zoom=Math.max(70,zoom-15);updateZoom()};
function renderOverlay(){document.querySelectorAll('.pageOverlay').forEach(x=>x.replaceChildren());for(const q of Q){const points=positions[q.num];if(!points)continue;const direct=points.length>1;points.forEach(([page,x,y],i)=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='hot';b.style.left=(x/768*100)+'%';b.style.top=(y/1024*100)+'%';const value=state&&has(q.num)?state.answers[q.num]:undefined;const locked=state&&(state.finished||state.mode==='practice'&&has(q.num));if(direct){b.textContent=value===i?'✓':'□';if(value===i)b.classList.add('marked');if(state&&state.finished||state&&state.mode==='practice'&&has(q.num)){if(i===q.correct)b.classList.add('right');else if(i===value)b.classList.add('wrong')}}else{b.classList.add('long');b.textContent=value===undefined?'Chọn ▾':q.options[value].replace(/^Vị trí /,'');if(value!==undefined)b.classList.add('marked');if(locked)b.classList.add(value===q.correct?'right':'wrong')}
b.title='Câu '+q.num+(direct?' – chọn '+letters[i]:' – chọn đáp án');b.setAttribute('aria-label',b.title);b.disabled=!state||!!locked;b.onclick=()=>{current=Q.indexOf(q);if(direct)choose(i);else showOptions(q,b)};document.querySelector('.pageBox[data-page="'+page+'"] .pageOverlay').append(b)})}}
function showOptions(q,anchor){closePopup();if(!state||state.finished||state.mode==='practice'&&has(q.num))return;const p=document.createElement('div');p.className='popOptions';p.setAttribute('role','dialog');p.setAttribute('aria-label','Chọn đáp án câu '+q.num);p.innerHTML='<b>Câu '+safe(q.num)+'</b><div class="submitInfo">'+safe(q.prompt)+'</div>';q.options.forEach((o,i)=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=(q.num.startsWith('T2')?'':letters[i]+'. ')+o;b.onclick=()=>{choose(i);closePopup()};p.append(b)});const cancel=document.createElement('button');cancel.className='close';cancel.textContent='Đóng';cancel.onclick=closePopup;p.append(cancel);document.body.append(p);popup=p;const r=anchor.getBoundingClientRect();p.style.left=Math.min(window.innerWidth-p.offsetWidth-8,Math.max(8,r.left))+'px';p.style.top=Math.min(window.innerHeight-p.offsetHeight-8,Math.max(8,r.bottom+6))+'px'}
function closePopup(){if(popup){popup.remove();popup=null}}
function choose(i){const q=Q[current];if(!state||state.finished||state.mode==='practice'&&has(q.num))return;state.answers[q.num]=i;save();render();if(state.mode==='practice'){byId('rightScroll').scrollTop=0}}
function setupAudio(){const w=byId('audioWrap');w.replaceChildren();audios.length=0;for(let i=1;i<=3;i++){const label=document.createElement('label');label.textContent='LISTENING · TASK '+i;const a=document.createElement('audio');a.controls=true;a.preload='none';a.src=data.audio[i];a.addEventListener('play',()=>audios.forEach(other=>{if(other!==a)other.pause()}));label.append(a);w.append(label);audios.push(a)}}
function begin(){const name=byId('studentName').value.trim(),clazz=byId('studentClass').value.trim();if(!name){alert('Vui lòng nhập họ tên học sinh');byId('studentName').focus();return}state=makeState(name,clazz,byId('examMode').value);save();current=0;showApp()}
function showApp(){byId('intro').style.display='none';byId('app').style.display='block';byId('identity').textContent=state.name+(state.clazz?' · '+state.clazz:'');setupAudio();render()}
function render(){renderOverlay();if(!state)return;const done=Object.keys(state.answers).length;byId('counter').textContent=done+'/'+Q.length+' câu';byId('progressFill').style.width=(done/Q.length*100)+'%';byId('modeHelp').innerHTML=state.mode==='practice'?'<b>LUYỆN TẬP:</b> Chạm ô trên đề → xem đáp án và giải thích ngay. Đáp án đã chọn không thể sửa.':'<b>KIỂM TRA:</b> Chạm trực tiếp trên đề, được đổi lựa chọn trước khi nộp. Không hiển thị đáp án hoặc đúng/sai trước khi nộp.';
const nav=byId('numberNav');nav.replaceChildren();Q.forEach((q,i)=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=q.num.startsWith('T2')?'T2-'+(i-3):q.num;b.title='Câu '+q.num;b.className=(i===current?'here ':'')+(has(q.num)?((state.finished||state.mode==='practice')?(state.answers[q.num]===q.correct?'done':'miss'):'done'):'');b.onclick=()=>go(i);nav.append(b)});
const q=Q[current],answered=has(q.num),value=state.answers[q.num],graded=answered&&(state.finished||state.mode==='practice');let html='<article class="question"><div class="qLabel">'+safe(q.task)+' · '+safe(q.num)+'</div><div class="qTitle">'+safe(q.prompt)+'</div><p class="submitInfo">Chọn đáp án trực tiếp trên trang đề bên trái. Bạn cũng có thể chọn ở đây:</p>';
html+='<div class="answers">'+q.options.map((o,i)=>{let cl='answer';if(graded){if(i===q.correct)cl+=' correct';else if(i===value)cl+=' wrong'}else if(i===value)cl+=' correct';return '<button class="'+cl+'" data-opt="'+i+'" '+(state.finished||state.mode==='practice'&&answered?'disabled':'')+'><span class="letter">'+letters[i]+'</span><span>'+safe(o)+'</span></button>'}).join('')+'</div>';
if(graded)html+='<div class="feedback"><strong>'+(value===q.correct?'CHÍNH XÁC!':'CHƯA CHÍNH XÁC!')+'</strong><div>Đáp án đúng: '+letters[q.correct]+'. '+safe(q.options[q.correct])+'</div><div><b>Giải thích:</b> '+safe(q.explain)+'</div><div><b>Dịch:</b> '+safe(q.translate)+'</div></div>';html+='</article>';byId('question').innerHTML=html;byId('question').querySelectorAll('[data-opt]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>choose(Number(b.dataset.opt)));
byId('prev').disabled=current===0;byId('next').disabled=current===Q.length-1;byId('submitTest').style.display=state.mode==='test'&&!state.finished?'block':'none';byId('submitTest').disabled=done!==Q.length;byId('submitTest').textContent=done===Q.length?'NỘP BÀI VÀ XEM ĐIỂM':'CẦN LÀM ĐỦ '+(Q.length-done)+' MỤC TRƯỚC KHI NỘP';
renderResult()}
function go(i){current=Math.max(0,Math.min(Q.length-1,i));render();const pos=positions[Q[current].num];if(pos){const box=document.querySelector('.pageBox[data-page="'+pos[0][0]+'"]');box?.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest',behavior:'smooth'})}byId('rightScroll').scrollTop=0}
byId('prev').onclick=()=>go(current-1);byId('next').onclick=()=>go(current+1);
byId('submitTest').onclick=()=>{if(!state||state.mode!=='test'||Object.keys(state.answers).length!==Q.length||state.finished)return;if(!confirm('Bạn muốn NỘP BÀI? Sau khi nộp, bạn không thể sửa đáp án.'))return;state.finished=true;save();render();byId('results').scrollIntoView({block:'nearest',behavior:'smooth'})};
function renderResult(){const el=byId('results');el.innerHTML='';if(!state)return;if(state.mode==='practice'&&Object.keys(state.answers).length===Q.length&&!state.finished){state.finished=true;save();renderOverlay()}if(!state.finished)return;const correct=Q.filter(q=>state.answers[q.num]===q.correct).length,score=(correct*10/Q.length).toFixed(1);const tasks=[...new Set(Q.map(q=>q.task))];el.innerHTML='<section class="result"><h2>HOÀN THÀNH BÀI THI</h2><p><b>Học sinh:</b> '+safe(state.name)+' · <b>Lớp:</b> '+safe(state.clazz||'—')+'</p><p><b>Chế độ:</b> '+(state.mode==='test'?'Kiểm tra':'Luyện tập')+'</p><p>Đúng: <b>'+correct+'</b>/'+Q.length+' · Sai: <b>'+(Q.length-correct)+'</b></p><h2>Điểm: '+score+'/10</h2><ul>'+tasks.map(t=>{const subset=Q.filter(q=>q.task===t);return '<li>'+safe(t)+': '+subset.filter(q=>state.answers[q.num]===q.correct).length+'/'+subset.length+'</li>'}).join('')+'</ul><p class="muted">5 câu Speaking cần giáo viên đánh giá riêng, không tính điểm tự động.</p><button id="repeatFromResult" class="primary">LÀM LẠI TỪ ĐẦU</button></section>';byId('repeatFromResult').onclick=resetDialog}
function renderOpen(){byId('openQuestions').innerHTML=data.openQuestions.map(o=>'<div class="openq"><b>Câu '+safe(o.num)+'. '+safe(o.prompt)+'</b><div class="muted">'+safe(o.note)+'</div></div>').join('')}
function resetDialog(){closePopup();byId('resetDialog').showModal()};byId('resetButton').onclick=resetDialog;byId('cancelReset').onclick=()=>byId('resetDialog').close();byId('confirmReset').onclick=()=>{audios.forEach(a=>{a.pause();a.currentTime=0});localStorage.removeItem(KEY);state=null;current=0;closePopup();byId('app').style.display='none';byId('intro').style.display='block';byId('studentName').value='';byId('studentClass').value='';byId('examMode').value='practice';byId('rightScroll').scrollTop=0;byId('resetDialog').close();renderOverlay()};byId('begin').onclick=begin;byId('studentName').onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')begin()};pages();renderOpen();if(load())showApp();
})();
</script></body></html>
